Name: Content Patcher - Lolita Fashion Bachelorettes
Author: ShurizenVenra
Description:
RoyalySpooky gave me permission to post this. I also want to thank paradigmnomad for doing most of the work by converting the original mod to work with Content Patcher.

Besides being a Content Patcher conversion, this mod also adds options for Maru: a lighter skinned sprite and a cuter nurse outfit. The original looks are included, so you can pick and choose your favorite looks.
